exposure: conservative management for gallstone-related disease during pregnancy
surgical intervention for gallstone-related disease during pregnancy
outcome: subsequent surgical intervention within 2 years after delivery
cohort: The study included 96 patients with 97 pregnancies who had symptomatic gallstone-related disease and were admitted to Skane University Hospital in Lund and Malmo, Sweden, between 2001 and 2015.
finding: Surgical intervention for gallstone-related disease during pregnancy increased in the later study period, was associated with good safety and fewer readmissions, and a majority of conservatively treated patients ultimately required surgical intervention within two years postpartum, supporting surgical intervention during pregnancy.
gest_age: Median length of pregnancy at first admission was 23 (13-31) weeks
